explanation: The worked solution agrees with direct differentiation: I gives mixed partials -4y and -2y, so it fails on an open set. II gives 0 and 0 and admits a function obtained by integrating its separate x and y terms. III gives 6x²y on both sides and is realized by f=x³y²-(2/3)y^(3/2) on y>0. Therefore II and III only is correct; the observed submission selected II only.
